verdict.rationale: Fellow documents no in-product automation or rules engine. Its automation surface is webhooks, where the integrator owns the receiving side and all action logic. Nothing in the pack describes versioning, review, or rollback of automations, and API path versioning (/api/v1) concerns the API itself, not user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
